column1: # Intended differences between an installed launch and an isolated one.
# tests/global_writes.py parity compares the configuration each stub `claude`
# launch received in the installed run (after `dx install`) and the isolated
# run, step by step. A difference passes only when a row here matches it.
# Columns (tab-separated): step, field, side, item, reason.
# step and item are globs where `*` matches anything; field is one of hooks,
# skills, plugins, mcp, settings, env; side is installed-only, isolated-only
# or *. Items are normalised: the Dex checkout reads $DEX_DIR and the sandbox
# home ~. env and settings items are NAME=value.
# A row nothing matches is not an error.
# The isolated run is the one launched with DEX_HOME.
# Values minted per invocation or measured from the host. The runs share one
# path, so everything derived from the repository path already agrees.
